meta.name: delight
meta.description: Add moments of joy, personality, and unexpected touches that make interfaces memorable and enjoyable to use. Elevates functional to delightful.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为界面注入惊喜与个性，让用户爱不释手
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让产品体验从好用升级到好喜欢
copy.tagline_en: Add joy and personality to interfaces, making them memorable
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn functional interfaces into delightful experiences

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在界面中添加微交互、个性文案、动画、音效等，让功能变得有趣、有温度，提升使用体验。
howto.when: 当你描述一个界面或功能，并希望它更有趣、更人性化时触发。Claude 会先询问目标用户、品牌风格等上下文，再给出具体建议。

say.text: 帮我给这个保存按钮加一点惊喜效果。
say.note: Claude 会建议按钮点击动画或成功提示。

say.text: 这个空状态页面太无聊了，加点个性。
say.note: Claude 会提供有趣的插图和文案建议。

say.text: 给这个错误提示写一句有温度的文案。
say.note: Claude 会给出符合品牌风格的幽默或温暖错误消息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds micro-interactions, personality in copy, animations, sounds, etc., making interfaces fun and warm, enhancing the user experience.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe an interface or feature and want it to be more engaging and human. Claude first asks about target users, brand style, etc., then gives specific suggestions.

say_en.text: Add a delightful effect to this save button.
say_en.note: Claude suggests click animation or success feedback.

say_en.text: This empty state is boring, add some personality.
say_en.note: Claude provides fun illustrations and copy ideas.

say_en.text: Write a warm error message for this alert.
say_en.note: Claude gives a humorous or kind error message matching brand style.
